entity.description: The edit log of a CalcGrid document (moqui-calc log.rs). An edit locks this row, so edits of every room and server are numbered in one order (lastSeq). savedSeq is the last edit the saved version holds, at savedVersion: a room is the saved version with every edit after it applied, and an edit at or before it is no longer undone. A saved version other than savedVersion was saved outside CalcGrid, and the log is begun again from it.

One edit of a CalcGrid document since it was saved, in the order of the document's log. kind is edit (ops: the edits as the view sent them, which each room applies over its own data), undo (targetSeq: the edit or redo it takes back, which each room undoes with what it took of that edit), redo (ops again, targetSeq: the undo it takes back) or revert (the saved version again: each room is opened anew). Only what was typed is here, never a value computed from the data. undoneSeq is the undo or redo that took this one back.
